title: Telugu Cholas: more rulers, families, records

boxes.title: Records: added detail
items: Kalamalla issuer = ==**Erikal Mutturaju Dhananjaya**==; **prose**; not fully available today
Potladurthi: CDX's p.133 list gives **Badapa Maharaju** instead
Telugu made a royal and ==**legislative**== language, replacing **Prakrit + Sanskrit**
Telugu epigraphic practice taken up by the ==**Eastern Chalukyas**==

rows: Madhurantaka = vassal of Chola ==**Parantaka**==; records from the **11th c.**

boxes.title: Nellore Chodas & others
items: **Tikkana Choda** (**Tikkabhupati**): son of Manumasiddhi I; ==put **Rajendra Chola** on the Chola throne==
Woman's property to daughters, daughters' daughters: ==**Purushartha Saramu**, **Sivadevayya**== (G2 2019)
Nallamala (Yerragondapalem, June **2026**): ASI copied **25** inscriptions, **2nd-16th c.**, incl. **Pottapi Cholas**
